description: Interval MEC where nature controls the long-run average. Demonstrates ROBUST interval-MDP long-run average reward, which Storm and PRISM cannot compute ('LRA with intervals not implemented') — an IMPaCT-only capability. Robust semantics: Chatterjee-Goharshady-Karrabi-Novotny-Zikelic, IJCAI 2024 (arXiv:2312.13912).
provenance: Exact. MEC {0,1}, r(0)=4,r(1)=0, stay [0.5,1] / switch [0,0.5]. Robust (nature minimises): nature drives+traps the play in state 1 => gain 0. Optimistic (nature maximises): nature keeps the play in state 0 => gain 4.

measured.note: Live runs 2026-07-01. Storm/PRISM cannot do interval LRA, so this is validated against the analytic value only.
